voc-engineering-delivery shares the runtime's code and only looks the checkout cache up for a wake's continuation (handler._continuation_generation: a read of READY, which its role may make); it never fills one, so it is not given the writer's name and may not invoke it (unset: the '' default, which is what keeps a wake's continuation from handing a fill ahead on: _continuation_generation hands one on only when the cache has its writer). Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.

voc-engineering-delivery shares the runtime's code; the name-based graph reaches a launch (handler.launch, which reads it) from _continuation_generation's fill ahead (_fill_unless_under_way -> _fill_later -> launch_coordinator), a path the delivery never takes: its checkout cache has no writer (ENGINEERING_CACHE_FUNCTION unset, above), so it hands no fill on and launches nothing. Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.

voc-engineering-start shares the runtime's code and runs start_run with launch=False only: it never launches a coordinator, so it never fills the checkout cache (runtime/handler.py _checkout_cache, reached by name through _ensure_coordinator). Only the supervisor, which launches, is given the writer's name and may invoke it (engineering-runtime.ts grantCheckoutCache). Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.
